misconceptions: Assuming integrate and incorporate mean the same thing whenever both appear relevant.

chains.frame: Which word best describes what Erin did with the chart in her newsletter?

beats.text: Erin placed a chart between two newsletter articles so readers could view it beside the text.
beats.decisive_clue: chart simply included in the publication
beats.reason: Chart simply included in the publication is the strongest evidence for incorporate here.

beats.text: She printed the chart itself in brighter blue ink on the next edition.
beats.decisive_clue: chart simply included in the publication; brighter ink used for the chart does not change that
beats.reason: The chart is still an included element; changing its ink does not create connected functionality.

chains.feedback_short: Chart simply included in the publication still decides; the later detail does not change that.
chains.feedback_deep: Integrate means join separate parts into a system that works together effectively; incorporate means include something as one element within a larger whole. The chart is still an included element; changing its ink does not create connected functionality.
chains.contrast_rule: Integrate: one update changes connected parts; incorporate: added as a component.

hints.attention: Does the chart work with anything, or simply appear there?
hints.axis: Integrate links parts so they operate together; incorporate includes a part without requiring shared operation.
hints.contrast: Integrate: one update changes connected parts; incorporate: added as a component.

chains.frame: Which word best describes how Pavel joined the club’s registration tools?

beats.text: Pavel linked the attendance list to the reminder system, so each new sign-up automatically received the correct message.
beats.reason: Sign-up records automatically control reminders is the strongest evidence for integrate here.

beats.text: Changing a meeting time now updates each member’s reminder without anyone copying the details.
beats.decisive_clue: sign-up records automatically control reminders; further evidence: meeting edits update reminders too
beats.reason: Automatic coordination from the registration records to the reminders shows separate tools functioning as one system.

chains.feedback_short: Meeting edits update reminders too confirms the earlier clue: sign-up records automatically control reminders.
chains.feedback_deep: Integrate means join separate parts into a system that works together effectively; incorporate means include something as one element within a larger whole. Automatic coordination from the registration records to the reminders shows separate tools functioning as one system.
chains.contrast_rule: Integrate: one update changes connected parts; incorporate: added as a component.

hints.attention: Look at what happens when one record changes.
hints.axis: Integrate links parts so they operate together; incorporate includes a part without requiring shared operation.
hints.contrast: Integrate: one update changes connected parts; incorporate: added as a component.

beats.reason: Basil was added as an ingredient is the strongest evidence for incorporate here.

beats.text: The leaves came from a prize-winning garden and smelled wonderful.
beats.decisive_clue: basil was added as an ingredient; quality and origin of the leaves does not change that
beats.reason: A fine ingredient is still simply included in the dish; neither quality nor source establishes system coordination.

chains.frame: Which word best describes how Aisha used her club’s timetable in the shared calendar?

beats.text: Aisha connected the timetable to volunteer shifts so a time change automatically reassigned the duty slots.
beats.decisive_clue: time changes automatically altered connected shifts
beats.reason: Time changes automatically altered connected shifts is the strongest evidence for integrate here.

beats.text: She later switched off that connection; the same timetable now appears only as a pasted note inside the calendar.
beats.decisive_clue: timetable is now only an inserted note
beats.reason: Removing the operational link leaves the timetable included but no longer working with the shifts.

chains.feedback_short: Timetable is now only an inserted note makes incorporate the better choice.
chains.feedback_deep: Integrate means join separate parts into a system that works together effectively; incorporate means include something as one element within a larger whole. Removing the operational link leaves the timetable included but no longer working with the shifts.
chains.contrast_rule: Integrate: one update changes connected parts; incorporate: added as a component.

chains.frame: Which word best describes how Amadou arranged the two support teams?

beats.text: Amadou gave both teams a single handover log; each team’s updates automatically shape the next team’s assignments.
beats.decisive_clue: teams coordinate their assignments through one log
beats.reason: Teams coordinate their assignments through one log is the strongest evidence for integrate here.

beats.text: Although they work on different floors, their daily duties still depend on that shared log.
beats.decisive_clue: separate floors do not disrupt operational coordination
beats.reason: Physical separation does not matter when the teams’ work is functionally linked.
